definitions.explanation: A state where different elements work together pleasantly or effectively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調和|ちょうわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The harmony of colors is beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{調和|ちょうわ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧。
examples.english: A life in harmony with nature.

examples.japanese: {調和|ちょうわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とれた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧。

notes:
{調和|ちょうわ} describes a state where different elements come together in a balanced, pleasing way. It implies aesthetic or functional compatibility rather than simple agreement.

- {調和|ちょうわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とれた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧ (well-balanced, harmonious)
- {調和|ちょうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain harmony)
- {調和|ちょうわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧ (to disturb the harmony)
